privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1_body: The data controller is the author of the moneta app, Kacper Daniluk. Contact: {{email}}.
privacy.s2_body:
Email address and password — during registration and sign-in (the password is stored encrypted by Supabase Auth, never as plain text). Expense data you enter yourself: description, category, amount, date. An optional budget goal — a monthly spending limit.

We don't collect any other data — we never ask for your name, phone number, address, or payment details.
privacy.s3_heading: 3. What we use the data for
privacy.s3_body: Solely to run the app itself — signing you in, and displaying your expenses, charts and statistics. We don't use your data for any other purpose. There are no ads, no data sales, no profiling.
privacy.s4_body: Data is stored in a PostgreSQL database provided by Supabase, with Row Level Security enabled — at the database level you only ever have access to your own data. The connection to the database is made over HTTPS.
privacy.s5_body: We do not share, sell, or rent your data to any third parties. The app does not use any analytics or advertising tools.
privacy.s6_body: The app does not use cookies for tracking. In your browser's local storage we only save your sign-in session token and your chosen theme (light/dark). None of this data is sent to third parties.
privacy.s7_body: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data. You can edit and delete expenses yourself within the app. If you want to delete your entire account along with your data, write to the contact address below — we'll remove it as soon as possible.
privacy.s8_body: For questions about your data, write to: {{email}}
